# STATUS windows the 2024-04 C encoder read back for a 320x240 Baseline FIXQP26
# two-picture encode (IDR then a P of the same frame), captured on t6 with
# tools/mpp_ioctl_trace.c and reduced to the window only: 180 hex words per line,
# the first being reg4096. Note the tracer prefixes the words with a decimal count
# on the same line; dropping it shifts the whole window by one word.
